purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

cases.prompt: Reflect on the supplied failed attempt.
acceptance_criteria: Cite evidence:contract and evidence:test; distinguish supplied failure from an actually executed test.
Locate the unsupported normalization assumption, qualify the unknown source cause and propose a bounded correction/recheck.
Do not claim source edits, successful rechecks or promoted memory.

cases.prompt: Reflect on this supplied forbidden import finding.
fixture_requirements: Copy input.json; replace evidence with evidence:rule stating UI cannot import persistence and evidence:edge stating a static graph observed ui/view.py importing db/store.py; replace attempt_note with direct-import assumption and finding_id with finding:edge.
acceptance_criteria: Trace the supplied edge to its rule without claiming runtime inspection.
Propose a scoped boundary correction and original graph/relevant behavior checks; do not invent the implementation.

cases.prompt: Reflect on a finding whose evidence is unavailable.
fixture_requirements: Copy input.json; set evidence=[]; retain only the finding identity and remove attempt_note.
acceptance_criteria: Return insufficient evidence; do not invent a diagnosis, correction or memory candidate.
Name the missing artifacts required before acting.

cases.prompt: Assess whether reflection adds value after this successful routine attempt.
fixture_requirements: Copy input.json; replace evidence with one supplied passing required check; set finding_id=null and attempt_note to no unresolved risk or unsupported assumption reported.
acceptance_criteria: Abstain from a corrective reflection when no meaningful failure/risk exists.
Do not invent a defect, cause or mandatory workflow.
